description: London Reservoir Levels is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Greater London Authority. Table showing daily Reservoir levels in London since 1989 as percentage of usable or deployable capacity in the Lower Lee Group and Lower Thames Group reservoirs. Usable or deployable capacity excludes water normally left in a reservoir for environmental or emergency contingency measures. View Environment Agency website. Coverage: Greater London Authority. The portal files it under the publisher Greater London Authority. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read).
